cues: At the centre, the path difference is zero for every colour, so every colour is bright there, and the central fringe is white.
Away from the centre, each colour has its own fringe width, violet the narrowest and red the widest.
So you see a few coloured fringes, violet edges nearest the centre, before they overlap into a blur of white.
text: Finally, use white light. At the centre, the path difference is zero for every colour, so every colour is bright there, and the central fringe is white. Away from the centre, each colour has its own fringe width, violet the narrowest and red the widest. So you see a few coloured fringes, violet edges nearest the centre, before they overlap into a blur of white.
